item.title: 4 things to know about the Super Bowl Halftime Show featuring Bad Bunny
item.description: Bad Bunny is set to make history at the Super Bowl on Sunday.

item.title: Seahawks, Patriots rivalry takes over Pacific Beach bars ahead of Super Bowl rematch
item.description: Two San Diego bars, Thrusters and The Sandbox, are preparing for a Super Bowl rematch between the Seattle Seahawks and the New England Patriots, with both expecting large crowds and extra seating to accommodate fans.

item.title: Pedestrian killed in possible hit-and-run in Pacific Beach
item.description: A pedestrian was killed in a possible hit-and-run in Pacific Beach early Saturday morning, and the suspect is believed to be driving a white SUV with front-end damage.

item.title: Foreign avocado imports squeeze California growers, notably during Super Bowl season
item.description: California avocado farmers are being priced out of the market due to an influx of foreign imports, leaving them unable to compete with the lower prices.

item.title: San Diego ramps up DUI patrols for Super Bowl weekend
item.description: Law enforcement agencies in San Diego County are increasing patrols this Super Bowl weekend to deter and detect impaired driving, with a warning that a first-time DUI conviction can cost more than $15,000 and carry the risk of jail time and vehicle impoundment.

item.title: Two of San Diego's finest starting for Seahawks in Super Bowl LX
item.description: San Diego natives Rashid Shaheed and Jason Myers will be taking the field for the Seattle Seahawks in Super Bowl LX against the New England Patriots, both having started their football journeys in SoCal.

item.title: 'Bad Bunny Day': Newsom stands by Super Bowl halftime show performer
item.description: Governor Gavin Newsom declared Super Bowl Sunday as "Bad Bunny Day" to show support for the Puerto Rican rapper and singer, who is set to perform at the halftime show and has been met with backlash from some Republicans.

item.title: Has the Super Bowl ever been held in San Diego?
item.description: San Diego has hosted the Super Bowl three times at the former San Diego Stadium, in 1988, 1998 and 2003, and is one of the few US cities to host multiple Super Bowls.

item.title: Petitions circulate to make post-Super Bowl Monday a holiday
item.description: The debate over whether the Monday after the Super Bowl should become a national holiday is gaining momentum, with some suggesting the NFL consider shifting the Super Bowl to Presidents' Day weekend instead.

item.title: Highlights from Bad Bunny's Super Bowl halftime show
item.description: Bad Bunny performed a setlist of his hit songs at the Super Bowl LX halftime show, featuring Lady Gaga and Ricky Martin.
